name: SCiEL
description: Evolutionary research framework with hypothesis, conclusion, reflection, research cells and reusable research tools. Arena provides a local whole-run driver and a separate read-only journal observer.
limitations: A local native CLI driver and saved-result reader are implemented at this source pin.
The Arena evaluator bridge currently admits only reference-sat with a unit-interval fitness profile; smoke is syntax-only and full performs one evaluation.
The native environment and a full model-driven run have not been verified. Pause, resume and broad task conformance remain separate integration work.
